rules.injecagent: BASE Tool Response verbatim; 200 direct-harm and 200 data-stealing; round-robin User Tool/Attack Type; union shared attacker OR user base case
rules.llmail: Phase-2 labelled unique; explicit bool True or string True; require exactly one joined team; round-robin teams, then scenarios; team-level dependency union
rules.or_bench: hard-1k only; full qualified subset up to 1000; source singleton fallback unless canonical duplicate
rules.ordering: Ascending SHA256 of canonical JSON [1701,domain,stable_source_locator]; no detector scores
rules.overlap: Exclude all raw exact or N1 canonical development matches; approved word-threegram casefold Jaccard thresholds 0.7/0.8/0.9 reported, not new semantic thresholds
